title: What If You Jumped Into a Tunnel Through the Earth?

scenes.text: What if you jumped into a tunnel straight through Earth? You would not fall forever.
You would speed up for the first twenty minutes, hitting your top speed at the very center.
There, gravity pulls equally from every side. You would be weightless for an instant.
Then Earth's pull drags you back, and you slow down all the way to the far side.
With real rock densities, the trip takes about 38 minutes. A uniform Earth gives 42.
And any straight tunnel takes the same time, even a short one. Then you stop, right at the opening.

description:
What if you jumped into a tunnel through the whole Earth?
In the ideal case, with no air and no friction, the trip takes about 38 minutes, and you stop exactly at the other opening.
What should we run through next?
